membership.heading: Three ways to belong.
membership.intro: Apply for the tier that fits how you want to spend your time with us. Every membership is application-based and accepted on a rolling basis.

trial.heading: The 30-Day Trial Pass
trial.body: 30 days of full venue access. Your window starts the night you walk in, not the day you sign up.
